feature_plan.rationale: Covers every covariate (direct numeric, gtrends, weather, labor), the panel keys (per-fold target encodings at jurisdiction/category/joint level), the opaque period_id via derived cyclical/ordinal date features, and the free-text DOH releases via TF-IDF-SVD plus a structural-missing flag. Cross-category auxiliary signal from the 5 unscored overdose_category rows is exposed as a separate lag/aux feature (never summed) to avoid double-counting. Lag/rolling target features and the cross-category lag are flagged experimental for the Step-6A' ablation gate since with only 77 periods they risk overfitting; all target-derived aggregates and encodings are fit per fold then refit on full train for the submission frame.

completeness_constraints.submission_frame_expansion: data/val/covariates.csv has n_rows=357 (51 jurisdictions x 7 periods, including buffer period dsZhPyK4). The prediction frame must be filtered to the 6 sample_submission periods and cross-joined with the 3 scored overdose_category values (all_drugs, all_opioids, all_stimulants) to produce sample_submission.csv's 918 rows (51 jurisdictions x 6 periods x 3 categories); dsZhPyK4 rows are used only as lag/rolling context, never emitted.

advisory_issues: Lag/rolling target features (only 77 training periods, per-group panel can be sparse) and cross-category lag signal are marked experimental pending the Step-6A' ablation gate.
